name: pyannote speaker-diarization community-1
purpose: Speaker diarization (who spoke when) from mono 16 kHz audio; also an 'exclusive' output for aligning with transcript timestamps (card).

license.name: CC-BY-4.0
license.notes: Card: "This pipeline is released under the CC-BY-4.0 license and will always remain freely accessible." Files are gated (accept conditions, share contact data); the CC BY 4.0 legal code was read in the Fluid Speech Pro repo. The better precision-2 pipeline is a paid API, not open.

architecture.kind: NON-AUTOREGRESSIVE pipeline: powerset segmentation + WeSpeaker embeddings + VBx clustering (Python, PyTorch)

engine_support.notes: Python child process; no ggml port found

strengths: No speaker cap (set num_speakers or bounds)

tona_fit.reason: Open diarization pipeline for meetings with more than 4 speakers; CC-BY-4.0, CPU-capable, every class. Python/PyTorch child process. Gated download needs a token.
blockers: no Tona audio module (Python side process)

open_questions: Behaviour with many speakers in long meetings
